The '''doohickey''' (from [[Middle English]] ''doo-hyckey'') is a widget used
for demonstration purposes.<ref name="intro">{{cite web
 | url = https://example.com/history
 | title = A History of Doohickeys
 | access-date = 2026-07-24
}}</ref> It is standardized in RFC 2324 and catalogued as
ISBN 978-0-306-40615-7.

== Design ==

The design follows three principles:

* simplicity — as few parts as possible
* durability
* affordability<ref>{{cite book |title=Cheap Widgets |year=2020}}</ref>

The governing equation is <math>E = mc^2</math>, implemented as:

<syntaxhighlight lang="python">
def energy(m, c=299_792_458):
    return m * c ** 2
</syntaxhighlight>
